title: Handedness: make triangles the consumer cannot eat

meta.note: Phase 1 test level. Reaction 4 creates anticlockwise (0,1,2) triangles, reaction 5 consumes clockwise ones. Swapping the two outputs 2 and 1 of reaction 4 makes it create clockwise triangles: x0 falls from ~0.35 to ~0.02 (4 seeds, t = 40); mean field is identical for both and predicts 0.46. Solvability not checked yet.
